# Testing Pyramid

A healthy testing strategy has many fast tests at the base and few slow tests at the top.

```
        [ End-to-End Tests ]     ← few, slow, high confidence
       [ Integration Tests  ]    ← some, moderate speed
      [      Unit Tests      ]   ← many, fast, isolated
```

The further up the pyramid, the more expensive to write, run, and maintain. Prefer testing at the lowest level that gives you confidence.

---

## Levels

→ [Unit Tests](../testing/unit-tests.md)
→ [Integration Tests](../testing/integration-tests.md)
→ [End-to-End Tests](../testing/end-to-end-tests.md)

---

## Guidance

- Most logic should be covered by unit tests
- Integration tests should cover boundaries between components
- End-to-end tests should cover critical user journeys only — use selectively
- All levels should run automatically in CI
